items.title: The fx adapter now runs the harness on the host
items.summary: The fx adapter for the AI SDK’s  now runs the harness and model requests in the same process as your application. Built-in filesystem and shell operations remain isolated in the sandbox.HarnessAgentThe adapter uses , the TypeScript library for fx. It no longer needs to install fx inside the sandbox, run a sandbox bridge, or expose a sandbox port. Model credentials stay on the host rather than being forwarded into the sandbox.libfxThe rewrite also adds:Sessions can be saved and resumed in a new host process.Update  to the latest version to use the new adapter.
